newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OPEC denies Venezuela admitted over-producing oil.
newsitem.headline: OPEC denies Venezuela admitted over-producing oil.

text.p: The secretariat of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) on Thursday denied news reports that Venezuela had admitted exceeding its mandated OPEC production quota.
A Gulf source had said on Wednesday that Venezuela's oil minister, Erwin Arietta, had admitted his country was in excess by 800,000 barrels per day.
The OPEC secretariat issued what its OPECNA news agency called a categorical denial.
OPECNA quoted it as saying that "the reports claim the admission was made during a three-hour closed door session held Wednesday evening.
"This session was only attended by the heads of delegation and the organization's secretary-general, so any information quoting other sources lacked any credibility."
Arrieta himself had earlier on Thursday given lobby reporters his own denial.
OPEC talks ended on Thursday with an accord to freeze current quotas for six months from July 1, with all 11 members committing themselves not to violate agreed limits.
